title: Use DeepL Translate
desc: Note: Requires you have an active DeepL account set up for API calls, and the API key saved in your User Custom Files folder as DeepL-API-key.txt

title: DeepL Language Code
desc: Select the language code for DeepL translation

title: Reset DeepL character counts (CAUTION)
desc: ** WARNING ** Resets your counters of characters sent to DeepL. ONLY click this if you wish to set counters to 0 to reset usage count for next billing cycle

title: Use Google Cloud Translate
desc: Note: Requires the Google Translate API to be enabled on your Google Cloud account set up for TTS. Set the Language Code to be used in the Ship AI Voice = Google TTS Voices section

title: Space Chatter : Translation services - choose if you want the Space Chatter to be translated from English. Requires a DeepL or Google Translate account.
Probability of translation
desc: The probability of the chatter being translated. Non-English speaking users set this to 100 to always translate, or a high percentage to sometimes hear English messages too. Englsh speaking users set this to a small percentage if you occasionally want to hear messages in other languages

title: Probability of random language
desc: The probability that when translating it will pick a random language. Non-English speaking users should set this to a number for occasional alternate language translation, English speaking users should set this to 100 to always pick a random language when it decides to translate a message

title: Translation service
desc: Select None if no translation required, else select which cloud service you wish to be used. If you have both Google Translate and DeepL accounts, you could choose to have DeepL dfor your main ship voice translation and Google Translate for your Space Chatter translation, to help manage your monthly free limits

title: Translate Station Chatter
desc: Whether to translate Station Chatter (docking / undocking / misc pilot chatter).

title: Translate Crew Chatter
desc: Whether to translate Crew and Deep Space Chatter (internal ship chatter of simulated crew).

title: Translate Galnet Chatter
desc: Whether to translate Galnet Chatter (topical news discussions).

title: Translate FC Greetings
desc: Whether to translate Fleet Carrier greetings (when docking / undocking from own FC).
